title: About Busaty
description: Learn about the mission and team behind Busaty, the smarter school transportation platform.

hero.title: Meet the Busaty team
hero.subtitle: We started in classrooms and now support every parent, supervisor, and school.

sections.heading: Our mission
sections.body: We believe school transportation should be safe, efficient, and human-centered, so we built Busaty to combine technology with care.

sections.heading: Our vision
sections.body: Become the trusted partner for schools seeking smart transportation and families seeking real peace of mind.

items.title: Safety first
items.body: We prioritise student safety and data privacy across every feature.

items.title: Transparency
items.body: Live information keeps every user informed and aligned.

items.title: Innovation
items.body: We deliver modern solutions for everyday transportation challenges.

sections.heading: Multidisciplinary team
sections.body: Our experts in education, mobility, and technology collaborate to deliver a product that matches regional needs.
